title: Way Too Soft
text: Way Too Soft. I guess you could say that I am picky when it comes to pillows because I did not like this one at all. It is way too soft and no structure to it at all. It has no support to it at all and just isn't comfortable to me. My boyfriend however loves it and has taken it over, which is fine with me. He loves a fluffy pillow and sleeps with it every night. So, if you like super soft pillows then you will love this one. If not, then you are gonna hate it, like me. Just the way it is.
